metadata.label: Shape model
metadata.coverage: JPL radar shape model of 1999 KW 4 Beta, with finite resolution and uneven radar coverage. The original mesh is retained before simplification. Display phase is arbitrary; libration is not reproduced. The grid marks unmapped visible-light terrain. Later mutual-event photometry favors roughly 1.3 times the original radar model’s linear scale. This view retains the original 2006 mesh dimensions.

celestial.sunSource: Scheirich et al. (2021) phase-bearing secular mutual-orbit model, extrapolated from 2000–2019 observations to the retained scene epoch. Current orbital phase is approximate; source/validation/epoch-state.json records limitations. Display attitude remains illustrative.
